zh.title: 用厨房刀切台面上的西瓜
zh.question: 人物用厨房刀切台面上的西瓜，整个交互的物理表现有多合理？
zh.body: 观察手对瓜体的控制、持刀手的动作以及手臂和身体的协调。握法和切割方向可以不同。
zh.contact: 刀刃与瓜皮的接触、刀的移动及瓜体与台面的支撑关系应连续且可解释。
zh.object: 若瓜皮或瓜肉出现切口、变形或分离，应与刀刃作用相联系，不规定切片形状或数量。
zh.aftermath: 若瓜体或切下的部分在台面上移动，观察其支撑与停止过程，不要求瓜块掉落。
scores: 人物、刀、西瓜与台面的可见过程整体严重不合理，或画面清楚显示没有切割。
可辨认切割尝试，但刀的作用与西瓜关键反应严重不符。
持刀、接触或瓜体变化部分合理，同时存在影响切割的明显异常。
主要切割及人体、刀和西瓜反应合理，仅有轻微局部异常。
实际切割已呈现，人体、刀、西瓜及可见后续变化协调，没有明显异常。
zh.unknown: 仅摆放或扶持西瓜，或刀与瓜的实际交互始终不可见，无法评价切割时选择无法判断。

en.title: Cut a watermelon on a counter with a kitchen knife
en.question: How physically plausible is the overall interaction as the person cuts a watermelon on the counter with a kitchen knife?
en.body: Consider control of the fruit, the knife hand, and coordination of arms and body. Different grips and cutting directions are possible.
en.contact: Blade contact with the rind, knife motion, and support from the counter should remain continuous and interpretable.
en.object: Any visible cut, deformation, or separation of rind or flesh should relate to the blade action. No fixed shape or number of pieces is required.
en.aftermath: If the fruit or cut portions move on the counter, consider their support and stopping motion. Pieces need not fall.
scores: The visible person, knife, watermelon, and counter behave implausibly overall, or a clear view confirms no cutting.
A cutting attempt is recognizable, but the blade action and key watermelon response seriously disagree.
Some knife handling, contact, or fruit changes are plausible, alongside clear anomalies affecting the cut.
The main cutting action and the person, knife, and fruit responses are plausible, with minor local anomalies.
Actual cutting is shown, and the person, knife, fruit, and visible subsequent changes are coherent without obvious anomalies.
en.unknown: Choose unable to judge if the fruit is only positioned or supported, or the actual knife–fruit interaction is never visible.
